hero.slogan: It's Your IT · Your Cloud · Your Rules
hero.lead: RPP gives small and mid-sized European companies their own private cloud — the power of the hyperscalers, without the lock-in, the surprise bills, or your data leaving the EU. Open source, deployed in one command, yours to keep.
hero.footnote: Open Source · Runs Anywhere · EU Data Residency · No Lock-In

outcomes.title: Enterprise cloud, on your terms.
outcomes.costsBody: Run on affordable European providers like Hetzner, or your own hardware. No per-seat licences, no egress fees, no bill that triples overnight.
outcomes.euBody: Your data lives where you choose — your jurisdiction, your hardware if you want. GDPR by architecture, not by checkbox.
outcomes.freedomBody: Built entirely on open standards. Nothing proprietary holds your business hostage. Move providers, or take it fully in-house, any time.
outcomes.teamBody: We build it, document it, and train your people. Expert-grade infrastructure — secure defaults, high availability, monitoring — without the expert headcount.

pillars.title: A complete platform, day one.
pillars.sub: The foundations that make the SovereignCloud Platform a production-ready internal developer platform out of the box.
pillars.gitopsBody: Every change is declarative, reviewed in Git, and reversible. ArgoCD keeps your cluster exactly as described — auditable history, no manual drift.
pillars.anywhereBody: Hetzner, OVH, AWS, Azure, GCP, or your own datacenter — the platform behaves identically everywhere. Start on a budget, move whenever it suits you.
pillars.k8sBody: The same battle-tested core the largest companies run on, sized and tuned for you. Scalable and highly available, without the operational headache.
pillars.aiBody: An AI gateway, locally hosted models and direct integration into the platform. Give your development team state-of-the-art LLMs through a single, governed gateway.
pillars.containersBody: Package once, run anywhere — identical from a laptop to production. No more "works on my machine", no environment surprises.
pillars.liveBody: A complete platform deployed in a single command. Your developers start shipping in hours, not after a quarter of setup.
pillars.ssoBody: One secure login across every service via Keycloak (OIDC / OAuth). Consistent access policies, easier audits, fewer passwords to leak.

modules.sub: Start lean, expand as you grow. Core services are always on; switch on optional modules when you're ready — the composer enforces what fits together and exports a deploy-ready config.

consultancy.title: Need a hand — or want to level up your own team?
consultancy.sub: Two ways to engage. We run your sovereign cloud for you, or we build alongside your people and hand over the keys — so the expertise stays in-house, not locked in a vendor.
consultancy.runBody: Design, deploy, and operate your platform end to end. You get a managed sovereign cloud without growing an ops team.
consultancy.empowerBody: We pair, train, and document so your people own the platform after we leave. You gain capability, not a dependency.
consultancy.k8sBody: Production-grade cluster design, GitOps pipelines, and operator development — from bare-metal bootstrapping to multi-tenant platform architecture.
consultancy.hostingBody: Your data stays yours. Self-hosted infrastructure on your hardware, in your jurisdiction — solid technical groundwork for GDPR compliance, with no cloud dependency.
consultancy.cloudBody: Multi-cloud and hybrid strategies without the complexity trap. Resilient, cost-optimized architectures across Hetzner, OVH, AWS, Azure, and GCP.
consultancy.platformBody: Internal developer platforms that accelerate your teams — Backstage portals, service meshes, secret management, and complete observability stacks.
consultancy.securityBody: Zero-trust networking, policy-as-code, and supply-chain security. Harden clusters toward BSI, NIS2, and GDPR requirements without slowing teams down.
consultancy.migrationBody: Legacy to cloud-native — with your team trained throughout. We containerize, replatform, and make sure the expertise is absorbed into your organisation.

items.a: Rocket Pad Platforms is a company that provides a private cloud platform together with the expertise to run it. Our platform lets small and mid-sized enterprises (SMEs) use cloud technologies and benefit from the scalability, elasticity, security and stability of modern public-cloud software development.

items.q: Where is Rocket Pad Platforms based?
items.a: We are a remote team working from across Germany. Our founders have many years of experience in cloud, DevOps and software engineering. Although we work remotely, we offer our services nationwide.

items.q: How can Rocket Pad Platforms support me?
items.a: Rocket Pad Platforms can support the transformation of your IT landscape and help you get the most out of cloud technology. We provide a platform that offers all the advantages of the public cloud (scalability, elasticity, resilience) as well as a mature internal developer platform with continuous deployment, logging and observability, authentication (SSO) and authorisation, database-as-a-service, mutual TLS, policy engines and continuous vulnerability scanning. With our platform you can focus entirely on building the software that matters to your core business.
Simply write to us at hello@rpp.gmbh — we will get back to you as soon as possible.

items.q: Does Rocket Pad Platforms offer IT outsourcing?
items.a: No, we do not offer IT outsourcing. Our focus is on providing our platform and on projects in which we support customers with it.

items.q: Can I order server hosting from you?
items.a: No, we do not offer server hosting. Our platform is a complete private cloud solution with all the required features and services. We are happy to set it up for you at any hosting provider of your choice, but we do not provide servers ourselves.

items.q: I have a complex cloud project. Can you deliver it?
items.a: Yes, we can help you with complex cloud projects. Our platform and our experienced team allow us to meet your requirements and build tailored solutions for your cloud project. Please get in touch to learn more and to discuss your specific requirements.
